title: Catherine Basie and leaving the road after four years
summary: Basie's wife Catherine, formerly burlesque queen Blondie Scott of Cleveland, never spoke to Humes and it did not bother her. After about four years Humes had enough of the road.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Well, what I'm not so sure of is, what we were talking about, I kind of remember where Catherine, Basie's wife, came into the picture. And she came from the mid-west or something, didn't she?
She was from Cleveland. They used to call her Blondie Scott from Cleveland.
Really? And she was on the burlesque circuit or something.
